scope: Independent CPU validation before the V37 administrative cutoff and V38 cold deployment

canonical_engine.verification: git_source_state applies the canonical patch to a temporary pinned-base index and compares the full worktree tree without modifying the real index.

checks.native_gpu_visibility: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=9; CPU-only with the physical experiment GPU untouched

new_regressions: JOIN/tool partial enqueue plans the same safe input checkpoint tail, excluding older output beyond the next reusable prefix.
A reduced live byte budget bounds the tail target and input/decode/Mamba reserves remain present.
Invalidation during enqueue prevents subsequent cold reclaim.
Post-enqueue reclaim leaves commands pending, does not wait for ACK, does not enqueue the tail and does not mark execution ready.
A bounded leaf scan advances past eight unbacked, referenced or in-flight candidates to a later eligible victim.
A later victim becoming in-flight is rejected after scan continuation.
Excluded restore target nodes do not hide a legal cold victim behind the non-target validation quota.
limitations: A progressing dynamic leaf snapshot is not an atomic census of every cache state.
Only a validated Host-backed cold victim can be reclaimed; active, shared, locked and in-flight pages remain protected.
A safe-tail capacity receipt proves allocator release only, not tail transfer, complete checkpoint readiness or next-request consumption.
CPU checks and source verification do not prove GPU throughput or JCT improvement.
V37 source remains frozen; deployment and performance must be verified on a new cold-started predictive run with fixed V29 native.
